newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian textile firm has new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian textile firm has new CEO.

text.p: The Egyptian state has appointed a new chief executive for United Arab Spinning and Weaving/Unirab, in which the state retains a majority stake, the government newspaper al-Ahram said on Friday.
He is Ali Ismail Khalaf, now chairman of the board and managing director, it said. He replaces Mohamed Munir Ghadir.

A small tranche of Unirab shares was privatised in 1994 but the state's Holding Company for Textile Manufacturing and Trade retains more than 95 percent of the company. It is slated for majority privatisation by the end of June 1997.
